title: IANA tzdb2026e source licence and zone semantics
summary: Primary tzdb LICENSE consulted: data public domain; optional date.c,newstrftime.3,strftime.c haveBSD3 code terms separately. Primary IANA page and bounded version file identify2026e,release2026-09-29. zone1970.tab17592 bytes,312 rows: overlappingISO2 country list,principal point inISO6709,ZoneID,comments. Country↔zone is many-to-many; catalogue points are not polygons. Historical rules and links are downloadable; reliable cross-zone equivalence targets since1970,earlier dates limited. GeoNames current-year fixed offsets cannot substitute historical rules or prove naive demo timestamp zones.
